entries.name: Bazaar Arena and Auction Test Pack

activities.title: Seeded Exhibition Match
activities.summary: A safe arena test: short fight, loud crowd, small payout, and a reputation hook for later systems.

ops.title: First Bazaar Match
ops.summary: Bin completed a controlled arena exhibition.

ops.title: Seeded Exhibition Match
ops.text: The crowd booed politely when Bin blocked too much. Apparently survival is less fashionable than spinning.

activities.title: Haven-Style Showcase
activities.summary: An exhibition that only appears after Haven proves Bin has a story worth advertising.

ops.title: Haven-Style Showcase
ops.text: The announcer called Haven a brand. Bin made a note to never let the announcer meet anyone from Haven.

activities.title: Small Mystery Lot
activities.summary: Spend arena winnings on a cheap sealed lot. Mostly safe. Mostly.

ops.title: Small Mystery Lot
ops.text: The lot rattled once after purchase. Everyone pretended that was normal. Bin hated how quickly he believed them.

activities.title: Pre-Collapse Medical Lot
activities.summary: A special auction lot unlocked by Zombie world scavenging. It can feed Earth hospital routes later.

ops.title: Medical Lot Bought
ops.summary: The Bazaar can trade in Zombie-world medical salvage.

ops.title: Pre-Collapse Medical Lot
ops.text: The label was in three languages and one of them was panic. Useful panic, at least.

activities.title: Prize Board Recap
activities.summary: Read Bazaar's compact recap of what other worlds have made possible for arena, auctions, and trade.

ops.title: Prize Board Recap
ops.text: The Bazaar does not care which world a consequence came from. It only cares whether the consequence can become a match, a lot, or a trade.

journalEntries.title: First Bazaar Visit
journalEntries.text: Bazaar is the testbed for optional loops: arena for repeatable risk/reward, auction for cross-world item sinks, and prize boards for future activities.
